text:
alex.k: Heads-up — ran a 3h perf sweep on the new coalesce-sampler changes. Main knobs: micro_batch_ms={3,6,12}, coalesce_delay_ms={0,2,5}, jitter_pct={0,0.2,0.5}. Using perf-bot traces and kv-hit metrics.

jia: Nice. Any obvious regressions vs the baseline? micro_batch_ms=12 previously looked bad for tail latency.

alex.k: Baseline (6ms, 2ms delay, 0.2 jitter): p95=48ms p99=220ms token-cost ~0.9. Big regression observed at 3ms microbatched runs when kv-hit drops under 70% — p99 jumps to 480ms.

naveen: Can you paste the profiler flame? Also did kernel selection shift? We saw fallback to generic-attn when token length variance spikes.

alex.k: perf-bot attached: ```flame.svg (link)```. Kernel histogram shows increased generic-attn usage at micro_batch_ms=3 due to more small batches causing per-batch kernel overhead. Also note KV cache miss ratio increases because we flush/prime less efficiently.

lina: So smaller micro-batches -> more churn -> worse kv locality. Did you try increasing coalesce_delay to absorb arrivals but keep latency OK?

alex.k: Yes. Increasing coalesce_delay to 5ms recovered p99 to ~200ms at 3ms micro_batch target (we effectively formed slightly larger minibatches). But token-cost rose 6%.

jia: Tradeoff looks expected. Any experiments with randomized jitter vs fixed jitter? Might reduce pathological alignment.

alex.k: Random jitter 0.5% reduced spike frequency but not magnitude. We think sampler policy needs a small hold-on-heavier-load rule: if queue-length variance > X, bump coalesce_delay adaptively and prefer kernel A (multiquery) to avoid fallback.

naveen: Let's open an RFC: adaptive-coalesce-sampler with signal inputs (kv-hit, queue-variance, kernel-fallback-rate). If accepted, small canary on dedicated pool.

lina: +1. Also add an eval prompt set to watch quality — more batching may change output if kv priming missed.

alex.k: I'll put a canary run tomorrow 9am PT. Tagging @perf-bot to collect traces + KV metrics.

perf-bot: scheduled canary run 2165090000, will collect traces and post summary.

jia: Thanks — we'll review after first 6h.
